next_step: Internal FINOPS review of cost models; follow-up w/ procurement 2025-03-12
notes:
Summary: Late-stage procurement; POC successful technically but unit economics are the blocker.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-01-22: Intro call (Lena/Ops) — described infra constraints, need VPC + KMS.
- 2025-02-04: Technical deep-dive w/ Marcus (SE) + infra team — validated latency SLOs (p95 ~55ms for 512-token chat on dedicated A100 pool).
- 2025-02-14: Demo + POC handoff (Fireflies ff_20250214_8352-silverpine-demo).
- 2025-02-26: POC results — throughput meets targets (120 qps for embeddings pipeline) but cost model estimate = ~$0.018/token with current config (quantized model + caching) which Finance flags as too high vs incumbent.
- 2025-02-28: Procurement asked for 12-month committed pricing with better unit rate and an option for burst credits.
- 2025-03-01: Internal FINOPS call; team says they cannot close without internal champion to absorb delta and run a 6–12 month total-cost analysis.

Customer quotes / color:
- CTO (A. Malik): "Great perf, but we run 300M embeddings/month — that price increase blows our margins."
- Head of Engineering: "If commit is too big we're stuck — we need a staged commit tied to metrics."

Key requirements pulled from calls:
- VPC + customer-managed KMS.
- SOC2 + audit log retention 24 months.
- Regionally governed data residency (US, EU).
- Pricing needs: staged commit (quarterly ramp), lower per-token at scale, options for local GPU placement to reduce egress.

Why stalled / loss risk:
- Unit economics: internal model shows Redwood baseline pricing would require 40–60% increase in cost vs their current provider at target throughput.
- No single internal sponsor willing to sign the contract given current C-suite runway.
- Procurement wants line-item comparables to Anthropic/OpenAI — Silverpine pushing incumbent pricing as anchor.
- Competitive motion: incumbent offered a temporary rebate for first 3 months; procurement is leaning toward lowest-cost short-term solution.

Actions taken by AE/SE:
- Offered Optimize review and a tailored batching/quantization plan to reduce token consumption (Marcus led).
- Proposed staged commit + roll-forward credits; sent pricing deck (drive link) 2025-02-28.
- Submitted formal security pack (SOC2, KMS FAQ) to procurement 2025-03-01.

Open questions / next steps (short):
- Can legal sign a 6-month pilot with fixed unit caps?
- Can we surface an explicit cost delta break-even comparison vs incumbent (token-level)?
- Identify internal champion (Ops or Product) to own pilot success criteria.

Short-term plan: Follow up after FINOPS meeting 2025-03-12. If procurement returns with revised commit demands, escalate to enterprise pricing team.

CRM shorthand: stalled — price. Reason: unit econ / commit size. Low likelihood to close this quarter unless pricing concessions or strong champion emerges.
public_notes: Stalled due to unit economics. POC good technically; procurement pushing back on commit & price. Monitoring but deprioritized until FINOPS finishes cost analysis.
